group.title: Shared-tool checkout
group.passage:
Shared-tool cabinet

The thermal camera and digital force gauge may be borrowed for up to three working days. Record your employee ID, the tool number, and the expected return date in the checkout system. Accessories must be counted before the tool leaves the cabinet.

If you need an extension, request it before the due date. An extension is possible only when no other employee has reserved the tool. Report damage immediately rather than waiting until return.

The red reference gauge is not available for general checkout. It stays in the laboratory and may be used only under the equipment coordinator’s supervision.
group.passageZh:
共用工具櫃

熱像儀及數位測力計最多可借三個工作天。請在借用系統記錄員工編號、工具編號及預計歸還日。工具離櫃前必須清點配件。

若需延期，請在到期日前申請，且只有無其他員工預約時才可能核准。若有損傷，請立即回報，不要等到歸還。

紅色參考量規不開放一般外借；它留在實驗室，只能在設備協調人員監督下使用。
